verdict.rationale: A deprecation policy with advance notice is a fair question for a hosted model inference API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a deprecation policy, notice periods, or a model retirement schedule. The model overview and choose-a-model pages only list available models and do not describe how models are removed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed
